name: LinkedIn Insight Tag
plain: LinkedIn's page script that reports visits and conversions on an advertiser's site to LinkedIn.
meaning: Sets li_fat_id (30 days) and reads bcookie (1 year) and lidc (24 hours); can match to a signed in LinkedIn member and send hashed email through its Conversions API. Safari 27 beta is reported to classify it as a fingerprinting tracker.

access.persistence: li_fat_id 30 days, bcookie 1 year, UserMatchHistory 30 days, lidc 24 hours
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can tell LinkedIn about your visits and actions on a site that uses the tag
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when you open a page with the LinkedIn tag
can: Report page views and actions like sign ups to LinkedIn
Link the visit to your account if you are signed in to LinkedIn in that browser
Let the advertiser build ad audiences from visitors
cannot: Run on sites without the tag
See what you do in other apps
Work if the tag or its cookies are blocked
Know who you are if you do not use LinkedIn in that browser
limits.differs: Safari and Firefox block third party cookies by default, which weakens the link to your account.

story.what_it_is: LinkedIn's script on advertisers' sites that reports your visits and actions.

marketing.name: Insight Tag
marketing.pitch: LinkedIn pitches the tag as a way to track conversions, retarget visitors and learn about site audiences.

story.for_you: You do not see the tag. It sets li_fat_id and reads LinkedIn cookies, and it tells LinkedIn which pages you opened. If you are logged in, LinkedIn can link it to your profile.
story.for_makers: Advertisers get proof that ads work and a list of visitors to retarget. LinkedIn gets web habits tied to jobs and companies. Safari 27 beta is said to limit it as a fingerprinting tracker.

use_cases.example: You visit a cloud vendor's page, then see its ad on LinkedIn the next day.
A marketer sees which job titles visit a pricing page.
A sales team sees visits from target companies and calls them.
A webinar page counts signups per LinkedIn ad.
A school tracks which LinkedIn ad led to a program inquiry.
Safari beta reportedly treats it as a fingerprinting script and strips its data.

risks: Tied to your profile when logged in

technical_bounds: Blocked by blockers and Safari 27 beta (reported)
Matching to member needs a LinkedIn cookie
Insight Tag collects URL, referrer, IP, user agent and timestamp

linkedin.how: LinkedIn Insight Tag and its ad stack use this technique on advertiser sites (see research/linkedin-case.md).

history.change: Reported to classify LinkedIn Insight on the fingerprinting list
